answer: Work waits on the terrace until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the walnut of the next round. The raven of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
